content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipėda district court the court has made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the movable property a car will be given to the applicant while the immovable property shares in a company will be awarded to the defendant the court has also addressed the applicants creditors and ordered the defendant to pay the costs of the proceedings the court has granted the applicants request for the declaration of personal property and the payment of debts the court has decided to support the request to end the marriage and has determined the amount of costs to be paid by the defendant
